verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's developer portal documents Windows on Snapdragon development with Arm-native Windows toolchains, and AI Hub provides official optimization tooling, but only for NPU/AI model deployment. Nothing establishes compiler maturity, CPU-level optimization guidance, or tier-one treatment across the OS and tooling ecosystem. Missing for 10: evidence of mature compiler support (e.g. MSVC/LLVM/GCC Arm64 quality), official CPU/architecture optimization guides, independent or hands-on confirmation of tier-one OS and toolchain status, and coverage beyond Windows-on-Arm AI workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, this architecture is a first-class development target — mature compilers, official optimization guidance, and an OS and tooling ecosystem that treats it as tier one

citations.quote: Qualcomm's developer portal covers Windows on Snapdragon development: Arm-native Windows toolchains, the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, and Qualcomm AI Hub for optimizing and deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs.
